payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

fact.question: Is the image as a whole visibly rendered as a drawing made from chalk?
fact.present_when: The depicted image as a whole is visibly rendered as a chalk drawing, rather than retaining substantial areas in their original non-chalk appearance.
fact.absent_when: The image clearly is not rendered as a chalk drawing as a whole.
fact.unknown_when: The images do not provide enough visual evidence to determine whether the image as a whole is rendered as a chalk drawing.
